+def test_statement_can_show_credits_only(bank, at):

+    client = login(bank["app"], bank["owner"])
+    url = f"/api/accounts/{bank['eur'].id}/statement?from=2026-05-02&to=2026-05-31&kind=credit"
+    lines = client.get(url).json()["lines"]
